# 部件匹配与非设计点

_Component Matching & Off-Design Operation_

发动机部件需要在流量、转速、压力和功率上共同工作。非设计点分析关注部件特性如何组合，以及高度、速度或油门变化后新的工作状态。

_Engine components must operate together within mass-flow, speed, pressure and power constraints. Off-design analysis examines how their characteristics combine as altitude, flight speed or throttle setting changes._

## 阅读要点 / Reading Notes

- 把压气机特性、涡轮吞吐能力和轴功率平衡放在同一个系统中阅读。

_Read compressor characteristics, turbine flow capacity and shaft-power balance as one coupled system._

- 区分稳态匹配与加减速等动态过程，记录控制变量和约束。

_Distinguish steady matching from acceleration and deceleration, and record control variables and constraints._

- 用公开教学模型理解趋势，不把简化模型结果当作某一实际型号的数据。

_Use public teaching models to explore trends without treating their outputs as data for a specific production engine._
